answer_1.quote: Recently, visual question answering (VQA) have achieved remarkable progress due to the rapid development of vision language Models (VLMs).
answer_1.outputs: The paper generates answers to visual questions based on input images and textual queries, which is a form of natural language generation in the context of multimodal reasoning.

answer_2.quote: For the VQA datasets, we assessed the zero-shot question-answering performance using a single input image. All results reported in this paper are averaged across multiple experimental runs.
